events.description: A person lies on the ground, apparently incapacitated, while another individual kneels beside them with hands placed near their head/neck area; the prone person shows no signs of voluntary movement or resistance, indicating helplessness.

A person with curly hair is engaged in a physical altercation: they are seen bending over, grabbing at another person’s clothing (e.g., sleeve or arm), and appear to be pulling or striking; the interaction involves mutual proximity and active physical contact consistent with combat.

A person with curly hair is seen kneeling over and repeatedly striking or pressing down on a person lying motionless on the ground (wearing blue and white), while others stand around; the victim appears helpless and unresponsive.

A person with curly red hair is seen kneeling over a prone individual on the ground, appearing to strike or press down on them while others stand nearby; the victim is motionless and appears helpless.

A large vehicle (likely a bus or truck) is visibly damaged and tilted, with its front end crumpled and windshield shattered; people are gathered around it in a street setting, consistent with a recent collision.
Multiple individuals are engaged in physical altercations near the white van; at least two pairs appear to be grappling or striking each other, with others intervening or surrounding them.
A large, agitated crowd converges around the van, with rapid movement, pushing, and multiple simultaneous physical conflicts indicating collective violent unrest beyond isolated fighting.

A chaotic outdoor scene with a large, dense crowd moving erratically; debris and scattered objects (e.g., chairs, barriers) are visible on the ground from frame f7 onward; individuals appear to be pushing, stumbling, and reacting to disturbances; no clear organized protest or peaceful assembly is evident—consistent with violent unrest or aftermath of a clash.

In frames f4–f8, two individuals in dark clothing (center-left) engage in close physical contact: one appears to grab or shove the other, who stumbles backward; motion blur and proximity suggest mutual physical combat rather than accidental bumping.
Large crowd engaged in violent unrest with police; objects thrown, barriers breached, and chaotic movement across the street.
Multiple individuals in close physical combat, including grappling and striking, amid the crowd and near police lines.
A person lying on the ground is struck and kicked by a uniformed officer while others stand nearby; the victim appears helpless and non-resisting.
A person in a white shirt is on the ground while multiple individuals, including one in dark uniform with a helmet and shield, stand over and appear to strike or subdue them.
A uniformed officer in blue helmet engages in physical struggle with a person on the ground; the person raises an arm defensively while being restrained or struck.
Large crowd in chaotic motion, debris scattered on street, multiple individuals running, falling, and engaging in confrontations; police in riot gear present and actively intervening amid unrest.
